value.rationale: A complete, natural exact fiber distribution of rank-one-projector additive convolution over all finite fields and matrix dimensions; it determines individual witnesses, not just existence, and isolates characteristic-two scalar-image and nilpotent rank-two obstructions. The global sum-rank law has a characteristic-independent rank-two mass with a sharp transfer between zero and rank-one sums. A motivated structural invariant rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
